behaviour: Render an InfoCard listing unread notifications with links to /notifications?id=<id>, per-item mark-as-read action, live signal refresh, and polling fallback.
rules: 1. Include the Apache-2.0 license header at the top of the file.

2. Export UnreadNotificationsCardProps ({ title?: string; limit?: number; pollingIntervalMs?: number; className?: string }) and UnreadNotificationsCard(props: UnreadNotificationsCardProps = {}): JSX.Element.
3. Use useNotificationsApi to call api.getNotifications({ read: false, limit, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }) where limit defaults to 5, re-running when limit or a refresh counter changes.

4. Subscribe with useSignal('notifications'); when lastSignal?.action exists, trigger a throttled refresh via lodash/throttle with ThrottleDelayMs = 2000 (matching NotificationsPage.tsx) and cancel the throttled function on unmount.

5. Check isSignalsAvailable from useSignal('notifications'); when isSignalsAvailable is false and pollingIntervalMs > 0 (default 30_000), register a window.setInterval that increments the refresh counter every pollingIntervalMs and clear it on unmount or when signals become available.

6. Render an InfoCard from '@backstage/core-components' with title={props.title ?? t('unreadNotificationsCard.title')} and className={props.className}, displaying <Progress /> while loading on initial fetch, <ResponseErrorPanel error={error} /> on fetch error, t('unreadNotificationsCard.emptyMessage') ('No records to display') when notifications is empty, or the list of unread notifications.

7. For each notification item, render its payload.title inside a Link from '@backstage/core-components' pointing to `${notificationsLink}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}` (using useRouteRef(rootRouteRef) with a safe fallback to '/notifications' if the route ref is not mounted), optional payload.description and relative created time via <RelativeTime value={notification.created} /> from 'react-relative-time' (imported with // @ts-ignore as in NotificationsTable.tsx), and an action button with aria-label={t('unreadNotificationsCard.markAsRead')} and RiCheckLine from '@remixicon/react' that calls notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [notification.id], read: true }), removes or refreshes the item on success, and reports errors via useApi(toastApiRef).post({ title: t('unreadNotificationsCard.errorMarkAsRead'), status: 'danger' }).
8. Render a footer/bottom Link to notificationsLink ('/notifications') with text t('unreadNotificationsCard.viewAll') in both populated and empty states.

style_from.reason: Follows notifications package conventions for hooks, signal throttling, translation, and Backstage UI / core-components usage.

uses.reason: Route ref rootRouteRef for linking to /notifications.

behaviour: Unit tests for UnreadNotificationsCard covering unread fetching, empty state, error state, mark-as-read action, signal refresh, polling fallback, and HomePageWidgetBlueprint rendering.
rules: 1. Include the Apache-2.0 license header at the top of the file.

2. Use renderInTestApp and TestApiProvider from '@backstage/test-utils' (with mountedRoutes: { '/notifications': rootRouteRef }) to test UnreadNotificationsCard with mocked notificationsApiRef, signalApiRef, and toastApiRef.

3. Test that getNotifications is called with { read: false, limit: 5, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }, each notification title links to /notifications?id=<id>, and the 'View all notifications' link points to /notifications.
4. Test that when getNotifications returns an empty array, 'No records to display' and the 'View all notifications' link are rendered.

5. Test that clicking a notification's Mark as read button calls updateNotifications({ ids: [id], read: true }) and removes the item from the list, and that a rejected updateNotifications call posts a danger toast via toastApi.post({ title: 'Failed to mark notification as read', status: 'danger' }).
6. Test that emitting a notification signal through signalApiRef triggers a re-fetch of unread notifications.

7. Test that when signals are unavailable (or useSignal reports isSignalsAvailable: false) and fake timers advance by pollingIntervalMs, getNotifications is called again, and the interval is cleared on unmount.
8. Test that the alpha notificationsPlugin unread-notifications home page widget extension renders through createExtensionTester from '@backstage/frontend-test-utils'.
